_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every headline number on this platform. Frontend, RESULTS.md, and the demo script must read/copy from this file only — never hand-type a number. This kills landing/board/RESULTS drift permanently (Phase 0.3). Every value carries a `source` pointing at committed evidence. `open_items` records known conflicts to reconcile in the Phase 4.4 consistency sweep.
status: provisional - only the isolcpus Arch run commit + measured bare-metal p99 remain (both hardware-bound); all text/number/PTP reconciliation done

naming.note: The wire is a custom binary SBE-style protocol (fixed 4B header + fixed structs), NOT FIX. Every surface says BINARY (SBE v1). FIX is a Phase 3 stretch goal; until it exists, no surface claims FIX.

planted_bug.bug: LIFO matching instead of FIFO price-time priority
planted_bug.note: Buggy journal is the SAME length as the correct one (852 bytes) — a threshold checker passes it; the byte-exact diff catches it.

byte_exact_replay.claim: Live TCP server output journal == offline replay, byte-for-byte
byte_exact_replay.note: A newer isolcpus Arch run (not yet committed) measured 25,759,344 bytes / 200k orders / 309,320 fills / 300,340 CO samples. Commit that run log to verified_runs/ and reconcile this figure in Phase 1/4.

run.host: Arch Linux 16-core, no isolcpus (shared dev host)

headline_gap.basis: p99 naive 173µs → CO-corrected 3.41ms, the only fully-tabulated run
headline_gap.note: Earlier prose on landing.html/README/ARCHITECTURE cited ~35x, derived from a ~98µs naive baseline with no committed ns table. 19.7x is the defensible canonical figure (judge can verify line-by-line). Reconcile all surfaces to this in Phase 4.4.

spsc_offload.note: Lock-free SPSC ring; CI asserts dropped==0 on every push.

scale_32bot.note: Committed figure 1,279,594. Newer isolcpus run reports 1,279,829 — throughput-bound, varies per run; both show Sent==Acked, 0 lost/double-counted.

latency_design.baremetal_p99: design target — low tens of µs, NOT yet measured
latency_design.note: Latency µs are host-dependent. macOS pinning is a no-op. Bare-metal isolated-hardware run is Phase 2.4; the isolcpus Arch run shows p50 ≈ 4.9µs naive on isolated cores.

open_items: RESOLVED (Phase 4.4): landing.html, README, ARCHITECTURE, DESIGN reconciled to 19.7x headline (20-75x host range) and 25,743,624 bytes / 200k orders.
RESOLVED (Phase 4.1): PTP 'LOCKED/badge' claims reworded to single-clock RTT across index.html, landing.html, ARCHITECTURE; PTP retained only as a production-roadmap item.
RESOLVED (Phase 0.3): RESULTS.md §3 order-count corrected 100,000 -> 200,000 (matches ARCH_LINUX_RUN.md §5 + canonical); unverifiable 'Fills 155,218' row removed.
